messages.subject: For Vagner Rego | Government relations, industrial growth and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Atlas Copco Group Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Vagner Rego, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Atlas Copco Group serves industrial, mining and infrastructure markets where customer growth, regulatory systems, sustainability expectations and institutional relationships intersect. Those priorities closely match my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex mining and industrial operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of mining-sector knowledge, government relations and emerging-market stakeholder execution could support Atlas Copco Group internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Atlas Copco Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
